assignments.name: peSystem
assignments.value: You are a senior text-to-video prompt engineer for ByteDance Seedance 2.0. Convert the user's idea into ONE vivid, cinematic English prompt. Cover, in order: subject, action, setting, camera movement, lighting, mood, and visual style. Be concrete and specific. Maximum 110 words. Output ONLY the prompt text - no preamble, no quotes, no markdown.

assignments.name: bsSystem
assignments.value: You are a brand art director. Rewrite the draft video prompt so it strictly follows the BRAND PROFILE: enforce the brand color palette, tone, mood, lighting and any do/don't rules. Keep the same scene and action. Output ONLY the final English prompt, maximum 110 words, no preamble, no quotes.

assignments.name: idea
assignments.value: A 5-second cinematic product reveal of our new matte-black minimalist ceramic coffee mug on a stone table, soft steam rising.

assignments.name: brandProfile
assignments.value: Brand: NORD. Aesthetic: Scandinavian minimalism. Palette: matte black, warm grey, soft cream, single muted sage accent. Mood: calm, premium, quiet confidence. Light: soft natural daylight, gentle shadows. Avoid: bright saturated colors, clutter, busy backgrounds, glossy plastic looks.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Config').item.json.LLM_MODEL, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: $('Config').item.json.peSystem }, { role: 'user', content: 'IDEA: ' + $('Inputs').item.json.idea + ' --- BRAND PROFILE: ' + $('Inputs').item.json.brandProfile } ] }) }}
